reports.description:
I have this address in Nicehash as the deposit wallet, when contacting the support requesting the release of the balance, I was informed that this is not my real wallet, as they explained to me ... 
_x000D_
Your NiceHash wallet is not a blockchain wallet, but a normal wallet that uses a certain Bitcoin address defined for deposits._x000D_
_x000D_
If you check this Bitcoin address on the blockchain, you will see that the transactions do not match the ones that are running in your NiceHash wallet. This is because we do not issue blockchain transactions for internal currency movements (mining payments and order payments), because each blockchain transaction requires a certain amount of transaction fee and several minutes or hours for confirmation, while our internal transactions are completely free and instant. Therefore, it makes no sense to use blockchain transactions for our internal accounting._x000D_
_x000D_
Be very careful when checking your outgoing (withdrawn) transactions on different blockchain monitoring sites. DE Address is not the same as the deposit address for your NiceHash account! _x000D_
_x000D_
Graciously,_x000D_
NiceHash Team_x000D_
_x000D_
So I was not convinced and I dont feel safe making any deposit in that wallet.
